configurePresets.name: exe-linux-asan-x86_64
configurePresets.displayName: Full exe (Linux native 64-bit) with ASan + UBSan
configurePresets.description: Compile and link nocturne with AddressSanitizer and UBSan, native x86_64 (no multilib). Debug build type adds -g for gdb usability.

configurePresets.name: exe-linux-vanilla-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Every authenticity toggle at the shipped behaviour, bar the host-kind ones that cannot be reproduced off Win32. The retail game as it was, bugs included, on a modern system.

configurePresets.name: exe-windows-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile nocturne.exe with clang against the mingw-w64 sysroot. Opt-in: needs a cross toolchain (sudo apt install g++-mingw-w64-x86-64) that no other preset requires. Configure fails with the package name if it is missing.

configurePresets.name: exe-windows-vanilla-x86_64
configurePresets.description: The vanilla lane for the Windows target. Same toggles as exe-linux-vanilla-x86_64.

configurePresets.name: check-windows-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Per-file -fsyntax-only verification against the Windows target, for checking portability without a full link.

configurePresets.name: exe-windows-msys2
configurePresets.displayName: Full exe (Windows 64-bit, built ON Windows under MSYS2)
configurePresets.description: Native build for someone who cloned the repository on Windows. Run it from the UCRT64 shell. Same target as exe-windows-x86_64, but with the MSYS2 toolchain instead of a Linux cross compiler.

configurePresets.name: check-windows-msys2
configurePresets.displayName: Syntax check (Windows 64-bit, built ON Windows under MSYS2)

configurePresets.name: exe-windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: clang-cl against the Microsoft CRT and Windows SDK, statically linked. On Windows, run from a Visual Studio developer prompt; on Linux, cross-compiles against an xwin sysroot (NOCTURNE_MSVC_SYSROOT, default ~/.xwin).

configurePresets.name: exe-macos-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Build on a Mac with Apple clang. x86_64 on Apple silicon too, where it runs through Rosetta 2.

configurePresets.name: exe-macos-vanilla-x86_64
configurePresets.description: The vanilla lane for macOS. Same toggles as exe-linux-vanilla-x86_64.
